Initial open-source maintenance release of Guest Check-in Automation.

### Included

- MIT license and contributor/security documentation.
- Twelve offline synthetic tests for the API, SQLite persistence, schemas, and Jotform parsing.
- Successful GitHub Actions checks on Python 3.11 and Python 3.12.
- Fix for the fallback parser when Jotform supplies a structured birth date.
- Improved development documentation and local secret-file exclusions.

### Important limitations

**Pre-release: not a security-audited production deployment template.**

Booking-read and processing endpoints currently lack comprehensive application-level
authentication and authorization. Do not expose the API directly to the internet.
The Jotform webhook still requires sender verification, and operators must protect guest
PII and configure all private integrations themselves.

Automated checks do not connect to real Telegram, Beds24, TTLock, OCR, or Google Sheets
services. See [SECURITY.md](https://github.com/ass3mble/guest-checkin-automation/blob/v0.1.0/SECURITY.md)
before deploying.
